title: Qualify recovered secrets storage and rotation
detail: Continue draft PR98 branch recovery/s23-secrets-1788723557430535400 at exact18c65b8e5a1e84c03a34791540d2dbd2acf9e034, preserving source/history with additive fixes and updating the existing PR without force push or merge. Repair raw-key Debug disclosure, unchecked ID path traversal, tenant/scope delimiter collisions, unauthenticated metadata and get_state authorization, non-atomic key rotation/store writes and unsafe permissions.
